title: Fatima ka Na Raha Koi Sahara Baba
body:
Fatima ka na raha koi sahara baba, aap kya chal basey andher hai duniya baba
Aap ki aankh hui band zamana badla, ab nahin zeest ki ek aan tamanna baba
Roke kehta hai kahaan chal basey nana amma
Dey jawaab aah batool unko bhala kya baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Rona shabbir ka har waqt raha aap ko shaaq, ab nahein koi jo dey usko dilasa baba
Yaad mein aap ki har waqt hai khoya khoya, ab na shabbir ki wo zid hain na rona baba
Ab to rone ki bhi takeed hai mujh dukhiya ko, zabt se shaq hua jaata hai kaleja baba
Ab to ye zoauf hain hathon se asa tak chhuti
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindagi ka nahein ab koi bharosa baba..
